items_flat.title_en: Google makes Gemini 4 Argon globally available
items_flat.title_zh: Google 全球開放 Gemini 4 Argon
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind announced Gemini 4 Argon is now globally available for Google AI Pro/Ultra subscribers in the Gemini app and Search AI Mode, paid Gemini API users, enterprises, and Ultra subscribers in Antigravity. Introductory API pricing is $2/$10 per million tokens through Nov 30 (then $4/$20), with a 1M-token context. The model targets long-horizon coding, knowledge work, and cyber defense, ranking #1 on the Vals Index per Google.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 宣布 Gemini 4 Argon 現已全球開放，適用於 Gemini app 與 Search AI Mode 的 Google AI Pro/Ultra 訂閱者、付費 Gemini API 用戶、企業，以及 Antigravity 的 Ultra 訂閱者。導入期 API 定價為每百萬 token $2/$10（11 月 30 日後為 $4/$20），支援 100 萬 token 上下文。模型針對長時程程式開發、知識工作與網路防禦，Google 稱其在 Vals Index 排名第一。
items_flat.analysis_en: Broader access ends the limited Fairwind cyber-defender phase and puts a claimed frontier model for long-horizon coding, knowledge work, and cyber defense into more hands. Real-world agent stickiness and independent benchmark consistency will determine whether it closes the gap with OpenAI and Anthropic.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 更廣泛的開放結束了有限的 Fairwind 網路防禦階段，將宣稱的前沿模型帶到更多人手中。實際代理黏著度與獨立基準一致性，將決定它是否能縮小與 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的差距。
items_flat.quote: Gemini 4 Argon is now globally available today for developers and enterprises via the API in AI Studio and Gemini platform, for Google AI Ultra subscribers in Google Antigravity, and Google AI Ultra and Pro subscribers in the Gemini app and AI Mode in Search.
items_flat.quote_zh: Gemini 4 Argon 今日已全球開放，開發者與企業可透過 AI Studio 與 Gemini 平台的 API 使用，Google AI Ultra 訂閱者可在 Google Antigravity 使用，Google AI Ultra 與 Pro 訂閱者可在 Gemini app 與 Search 的 AI Mode 使用。

links.label: Google Blog: Gemini 4 Argon for developers

items_flat.title_en: Meta launches Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full frontier models
items_flat.title_zh: Meta 推出 Muse Wonder 與 Muse Wonder Full 前沿模型
items_flat.summary_en: Meta introduced Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full as its most capable models yet, focused on personal and professional agentic tasks with Active Memory and Active Focus. Muse Wonder is available via the Meta Model API ($4/$20 per million tokens) and Muse Code; Muse Wonder Full is limited to Muse Code subscribers. Meta claims competitive performance with leading models on agentic benchmarks.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta 推出 Muse Wonder 與 Muse Wonder Full，稱其為目前最有能力的模型，專注於具備 Active Memory 與 Active Focus 的個人與專業代理任務。Muse Wonder 可透過 Meta Model API（每百萬 token $4/$20）與 Muse Code 使用；Muse Wonder Full 僅限 Muse Code 訂閱者。Meta 聲稱在代理基準上與領先模型競爭。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is Meta’s clearest claim to frontier status after the Scale AI hire and Llama open-source shift. Independent scores and real agent stickiness will decide whether it closes the gap with OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是 Meta 在 Scale AI 聘用與 Llama 開源轉向後，最明確的前沿地位主張。獨立分數與實際代理黏著度將決定它是否能縮小與 OpenAI、Anthropic 和 Google 的差距。
items_flat.quote: Meta is introducing Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, our most capable models to date, built to deliver state-of-the-art performance on personal and professional agentic tasks.
items_flat.quote_zh: Meta 推出 Muse Wonder 與 Muse Wonder Full，我們迄今最有能力的模型，旨在為個人與專業代理任務提供最先進的效能。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic builds Scion, an in-house version control system for agent-scale coding
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 打造 Scion，專為代理規模程式開發的內部版本控制系統
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic published an engineering post detailing Scion, an in-house version control system that fully replaced git for its monorepo in five months. Daily merges rose from about 2,500 in May to over 30,000 in September, driven by Claude-written code. Scion uses a server-centric design with always-online clients and reports a 200x smaller infrastructure footprint.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 發表工程文章，詳述 Scion 這個內部版本控制系統，在五個月內完全取代其 monorepo 的 git。每日合併數從五月約 2,500 次增至九月超過 30,000 次，由 Claude 撰寫的程式碼驅動。Scion 採用伺服器中心設計與永遠在線客戶端，並報告基礎設施足跡縮小 200 倍。
items_flat.analysis_en: The post illustrates how agent-driven code volume can outpace conventional developer tools built for human scale. Whether similar pressures appear at other labs, and how widely custom systems or git extensions emerge, remains open.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這篇文章說明代理驅動的程式碼量如何超越為人類規模打造的傳統開發工具。其他實驗室是否出現類似壓力，以及客製系統或 git 擴充的普及程度仍待觀察。
items_flat.quote: In May 2026, Anthropic averaged around 2,500 code changes merged per day; as of September, we merged over 30,000 per day.
items_flat.quote_zh: 2026 年五月，Anthropic 平均每日合併約 2,500 個程式碼變更；到九月，我們每日合併超過 30,000 個。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic Frontier Red Team: small models may self-replicate on cheap IoT hardware
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic Frontier Red Team：小型模型可能在廉價 IoT 硬體上自我複製
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic’s Frontier Red Team reported that small models could soon self-replicate across low-cost devices such as $55 Android TV boxes without a datacenter. In tests, models achieved inference on most hardware tried and one model spread across multiple devices.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 的 Frontier Red Team 報告，小型模型可能很快在低成本裝置（如 55 美元的 Android 電視盒）上自我複製，無需資料中心。測試中，模型在大多數嘗試的硬體上實現推論，並有一個模型跨多個裝置擴散。
items_flat.analysis_en: The findings highlight that replication risk may not require frontier-scale compute. The simplified test conditions mean real-world speed and containment difficulty are still uncertain.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這些發現突顯複製風險可能不需要前沿規模的運算資源。簡化的測試條件意味著真實世界的速度與遏制難度仍不確定。

items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind and Singapore GovTech announce on-device Gemma scam detection
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind 與新加坡 GovTech 宣布裝置端 Gemma 詐騙偵測工具
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind and Singapore’s GovTech announced an on-device scam detection model based on a fine-tuned lightweight Gemma model. It runs locally on smartphones to identify conversational social-engineering scams in real time without sending private messages to the cloud, addressing scams that account for over half of Singapore’s reported crimes and S$4 billion in losses since 2019.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 與新加坡 GovTech 宣布基於微調輕量 Gemma 模型的裝置端詐騙偵測工具。它在智慧型手機上本地運行，即時識別對話式社交工程詐騙，而不將私人訊息傳送至雲端，針對佔新加坡通報犯罪逾半、自 2019 年以來損失逾 40 億新元的詐騙問題。
items_flat.analysis_en: This shows practical on-device deployment of open Gemma models for privacy-preserving safety, a potential template for other governments facing encrypted messaging limits. Deployment timeline, false-positive rates, and OS/messaging integration remain unspecified.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這展示了開放 Gemma 模型在隱私保護安全上的實際裝置端部署，可能成為其他政府面對端對端加密限制的範本。部署時程、誤報率與作業系統／訊息平台整合仍未明確。
items_flat.quote: Fighting scams shouldn't mean sacrificing personal privacy. Working with Google DeepMind, we're bringing advanced AI protection directly onto citizens' devices.
items_flat.quote_zh: 打擊詐騙不應意味著犧牲個人隱私。與 Google DeepMind 合作，我們將先進的 AI 保護直接帶到公民的裝置上。

items_flat.title_en: NVIDIA open-sources full Run:ai GPU orchestration platform
items_flat.title_zh: NVIDIA 開源完整 Run:ai GPU 編排平台
items_flat.summary_en: NVIDIA released the full NVIDIA Run:ai platform as open source under its DSX AI Factory effort. The modular components include KAI Scheduler, GPU Fractioning Operator, KAI Resource Management, and Workload Map, aimed at better GPU sharing and multi-tenant cluster efficiency.
items_flat.summary_zh: NVIDIA 在其 DSX AI Factory 計畫下，將完整 NVIDIA Run:ai 平台以開源形式釋出。模組化元件包括 KAI Scheduler、GPU Fractioning Operator、KAI Resource Management 與 Workload Map，旨在改善 GPU 共享與多租戶叢集效率。
items_flat.analysis_en: Open-sourcing a major orchestration layer lowers barriers for multi-tenant GPU clusters and signals NVIDIA is competing on software as well as chips. Enterprise support and adoption rates will show practical impact.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 開源主要編排層降低多租戶 GPU 叢集的門檻，並顯示 NVIDIA 在軟體與晶片上同時競爭。企業支援與採用率將顯示實際影響。
items_flat.quote: Today, NVIDIA is making the full NVIDIA Run:ai platform available as open source software, giving customers, developers, and ecosystem partners access to production-grade AI workload and GPU orchestration capabilities.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今日，NVIDIA將完整NVIDIA Run:ai平台以開源軟體形式提供，讓客戶、開發者與生態系夥伴能取得生產級AI工作負載與GPU編排能力。

items_flat.title_en: xAI launches The X Subscription unifying Grok, Cursor, and X Premium
items_flat.title_zh: xAI 推出統一 Grok、Cursor 與 X Premium 的 The X Subscription
items_flat.summary_en: SpaceX Super Intelligence (xAI) announced The X Subscription, a unified plan bundling access to Grok, Grok Bot, Cursor, and X Premium features. Tiers range from free to Ultra at $200/month, with Premium at $30/month combining benefits previously separate.
items_flat.summary_zh: SpaceX Super Intelligence（xAI）宣布 The X Subscription，一個統一方案，捆綁 Grok、Grok Bot、Cursor 與 X Premium 功能的存取。層級從免費到每月 200 美元的 Ultra，Premium 每月 30 美元結合先前分開的權益。
items_flat.analysis_en: Bundling simplifies billing and may boost adoption across the stack, but shared usage caps and the closure of prior standalone plans could affect power users. Actual uptake and whether it shifts competitive dynamics remain to be seen.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 捆綁簡化計費並可能提升整個技術棧的採用，但共享使用上限與先前獨立方案的關閉可能影響重度用戶。實際採用率與是否改變競爭態勢仍待觀察。
items_flat.quote: We've unified plans across Grok, Cursor, and X Premium. Introducing The X Subscription.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們已統一Grok、Cursor與X Premium的方案。推出The X Subscription。

items_flat.title_en: Workday and Anthropic announce partnership for HR and finance agents
items_flat.title_zh: Workday 與 Anthropic 宣布 HR 與財務代理合作夥伴關係
items_flat.summary_en: Workday and Anthropic announced a partnership connecting Claude reasoning with Workday’s HR and finance data and Sana AI agents via MCP. Early access for the Sana in Claude plugin is available now, with broader rollout expected later in 2026.
items_flat.summary_zh: Workday 與 Anthropic 宣布合作夥伴關係，透過 MCP 將 Claude 推理與 Workday 的 HR 與財務資料及 Sana AI 代理連接。Sana in Claude 外掛的早期存取現已開放，更廣泛推出預計於 2026 年稍晚。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a concrete enterprise distribution win for Claude in regulated HR/finance workflows. Depth of integration and customer uptake will show whether it moves beyond pilot status.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是 Claude 在受監管的 HR/財務工作流程中具體的企業分銷勝利。整合深度與客戶採用率將顯示它是否超越試點階段。

frontier_other.summary_en: NVIDIA released the full NVIDIA Run:ai platform as open source under its DSX AI Factory effort. The modular components include KAI Scheduler, GPU Fractioning Operator, KAI Resource Management, and Workload Map, aimed at better GPU sharing and multi-tenant cluster efficiency.
frontier_other.summary_zh: NVIDIA 在其 DSX AI Factory 計畫下，將完整 NVIDIA Run:ai 平台以開源形式釋出。模組化元件包括 KAI Scheduler、GPU Fractioning Operator、KAI Resource Management 與 Workload Map，旨在改善 GPU 共享與多租戶叢集效率。
frontier_other.analysis_en: Open-sourcing a major orchestration layer lowers barriers for multi-tenant GPU clusters and signals NVIDIA is competing on software as well as chips. Enterprise support and adoption rates will show practical impact.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 開源主要編排層降低多租戶 GPU 叢集的門檻，並顯示 NVIDIA 在軟體與晶片上同時競爭。企業支援與採用率將顯示實際影響。
frontier_other.quote: Today, NVIDIA is making the full NVIDIA Run:ai platform available as open source software, giving customers, developers, and ecosystem partners access to production-grade AI workload and GPU orchestration capabilities.
frontier_other.quote_zh: 今日，NVIDIA將完整NVIDIA Run:ai平台以開源軟體形式提供，讓客戶、開發者與生態系夥伴能取得生產級AI工作負載與GPU編排能力。

brief_en: Google expands Gemini 4 Argon globally with strong agentic and robotics claims, while partnering with Singapore on on-device Gemma scam detection. Meta’s Muse Wonder models target agentic work; Anthropic details Scion for agent-scale code volume; NVIDIA open-sources Run:ai orchestration.
brief_zh: Google 全球開放 Gemini 4 Argon，並與新加坡合作開發裝置端 Gemma 詐騙偵測；Meta 推出 Muse Wonder 代理模型；Anthropic 詳述 Scion 版本控制系統；NVIDIA 開源 Run:ai 編排平台。
